name: Tanooki Auth
subtitle: Private 2FA codes, no account
promotionalText: Two-factor codes that stay on your device, encrypted. No account, no ads, no tracking. Free to use, with an optional one-time Premium upgrade.
description:
Tanooki Auth gives you the six-digit codes websites ask for when you log in with two-factor authentication. Your codes stay on your own devices, encrypted. There is no account to make, no ads and no tracking.

FREE, WITH NO LIMITS
• Unlimited accounts.
• Add an account by scanning its QR code, picking a screenshot of it from your photos, or pasting its setup link. Paste many links at once.
• Move your accounts over from Google Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS, Authy, Bitwarden, 1Password or Apple Passwords.
• Tap a code to copy it.
• Time-based codes, counter-based codes and Steam Guard codes.
• Favorites, folders, tags, notes and search keep a long list tidy.
• Keep each account's recovery codes right next to it.
• Lock the app with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode.
• Encrypted backups protected by a password only you know, plus a printable paper backup.
• Deleted accounts wait in the trash for 30 days.
• Step-by-step guides for turning on two-factor login at 40 popular sites.
• Works offline: codes come from your device's clock.
• On a Mac, the free Tanooki Auth browser extension for Chrome, Brave and Edge fills codes in for you, only on the exact site each code is saved for.
• In English, Spanish, French, German and Japanese.

PREMIUM: PAY ONCE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Every Premium theme, including Pastel Pink and Pastel Blue.
• Different app icons, including seasonal ones.
• Sync across your devices, end-to-end encrypted, through iCloud or the Tanooki relay.
• Approve codes from your phone when the browser extension asks for one.
• Breach alerts: find out when a website you have an account for is in a known data breach. Checked on your device; nothing about you is sent.
• Share one account securely with someone you trust.
• Every Premium feature added later.

Premium is a one-time in-app purchase, for just you or for your whole family. It is never a subscription, and everything listed under Free stays free.

PRIVACY
Your codes live in one file locked with AES-256-GCM, and the key stays in your device's Keychain. The app checks the time now and then so it can warn you if your clock is off, because a wrong clock makes codes fail; nothing about you or your accounts is sent. Sync, phone approval, breach alerts and buying Premium only go online if you choose them. The source code is public under the GPL-3.0 license.

Made by Maddie at Tanooki Studios.
